articles.title: argpeek added to PyPI
articles.summary: Argpeek is a software tool designed for inspecting subprocesses, revealing the exact arguments (argv) and process metadata they receive. It offers a unique shell-safe replay capability, allowing users to analyze process inputs and behavior without executing the code. This is particularly useful for debugging complex systems, understanding program interactions, and ensuring robust technical operations, which can be a valuable skill in various technical roles within the services.

articles.title: Mehbooba Mufti announces protest on seventh anniversary of abrogation of Article 370, apologizes for Jantar Mantar remark
articles.summary: The People's Democratic Party (PDP) has announced protests across Jammu and Kashmir on August 5, demanding the restoration of Article 370 and Article 35A. The party also passed a resolution reaffirming its commitment to these provisions, which were abrogated in 2019. This highlights continued political dissent in the region concerning its special constitutional status.
